crossRefs.note: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

translations.web: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
translations.bsb: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
translations.kjv: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
translations.asv: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
